clips.title: The story
paras: At Goldshire, Garments of the Light mark a novice priest’s first trial under Priestess Josetta. She sends you east to Crystal Lake to tend the wounded Guard Roberts. The work tests your healing and earns you vestments recognized by the Church of the Holy Light.

Priestess Josetta teaches acolytes who come to Goldshire from Northshire Abbey. Before the Church of the Holy Light formally recognizes a novice, she tests their skill with divine power. When Guard Roberts is reported wounded by the lake east of Goldshire, Josetta sends you to care for him. His need gives you a chance to prove your healing in practice.

You need to do more than close Guard Roberts’s wounds. Mend him with restorative prayers, then strengthen him with a blessing of fortitude. Stormwind’s forces are stretched thin, and local garrisons face kobolds and bandits. Josetta teaches that priests help defenders endure danger. Healing Roberts will aid the township and show that you can support its guards.

After treating Guard Roberts, return to the Lion’s Pride Inn. There you receive your first formal robes, a sign of approval and fellowship from the priesthood in Stormwind. The robes are not required for further training, but they show that the Church recognizes you as a servant of the Holy Light.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Normally I put forth a small challenge to followers of the Light to test their skill. I want to see if they are worthy of wearing their first robes—a sign that the church outwardly approves of the priest and supports them.

But this situation is a bit different. One of Goldshire's citizens saw an injured guard near the lake to the east of here. His name is Roberts. Find him, heal him, fortify his body and return here. If you can do that for me, then I will consider your test complete.

clips.title: Progress
paras: As you may have already learned, our healing magics are vital to the survival of our people in these harsh times--especially to adventurers and heroes who take up arms and magic to fight back so many different threats.

You would do well to always remember how important that skill is. That, coupled with Fortitude, make your companions far more capable in battle since they will be able to stand up to a greater number of blows.
Do not let anyone dismiss how powerful your magics are.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, friend. With one more healthy guard out there to help the town, we'll be that much safer. I'm glad to see you're already learning to use your abilities wisely. If you feel you are ready for more training at any time, please come back to me. But for now, take this robe. It will let others know that you are one of our order. If you don't want to wear it, that's fine. Later there will be more tests and this robe isn't necessary for those.
